title: alchemilla vulgaris var. longiuscula
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris var. longiuscula, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, such as treating menstrual disorders, heavy bleeding, and inflammation, due to its astringent and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in relieving menstrual cramps and other gynecological issues. The bioactive constituents of Lady's Mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
